statusDetail: Cloudflare managed security verification intercepted the document in headless Chrome and remained on “Performing security verification / Verifying…” after a 15-second wait; raw fetch returned HTTP 403. The origin content and representative routes could not be reached.

page.notes: Only Cloudflare challenge markup was observable. The site template and primary journey could not be classified.

artifacts.caption: Desktop entry-page capture showing the Cloudflare security verification wall.
Mobile capture after a 15-second wait; verification still did not complete.
Rendered DOM is Cloudflare challenge markup rather than the site origin content.
Raw crawler fetch returned HTTP 403 and browser rendering remained the challenge.
Discoverability browser-view capture of the challenge.
Discoverability crawler-view capture of the blocked response.
robots.txt was reachable after redirect to the apex host; used only for route recon.
sitemap.xml was reachable for route recon, but listed pages could not be audited behind the challenge.
